    Description

    Coin collectible.

    Handles: - Collectible spawning - Collectible collision - Score / coin gain - Collection particles

    Base interface for all cookie abilities.

    Main application class.

    Cookie Selection view - pick a cookie, then proceed to stage selection.

    Main gameplay scene.

    Ghost ability for Pirate Cookie.

    Handles: - Obstacle spawning - Obstacle collision - Damage handling

    Small particle effect used when collecting items.

    PlayButton

    Interface for any object that can be drawn on a JavaFX Canvas.
